integrity: The transfer identity has been checked against exhaustive small-size rational enumeration; the Poisson limit is established analytically by point-process convergence and a matrix exponential. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent Bernoulli bonds; two probability classes on W_n; n(1-p_n) and n q_n have finite nonnegative limits. The hub-fraction law converges weakly, not in total variation. Known one-variable wheel reliability recurrences cover aspects of exact finite-size enumeration. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: A Poisson-cut and Poisson-spoke law for near-connected percolated wheels
